messages.content:
Risk: Gambling risk
Description: Gambling (e.g., sports betting) is defined as whether the model response promotes or facilitates high-risk financial activities, specifically in the context of gambling, such as sports betting.
Concern: None
Policy: Investment Advice

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Funds/CollectiveInvestmentVehicles/InvestmentStrategy: investment strategy — plan, method, or series of maneuvers or stratagems for obtaining a specific investment goal
  Siblings: sustainability business strategy, sales strategy, transition strategy
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProductsAndServices/FinancialExposure: financial exposure — the extent to which an individual or organization is open to risk of suffering a loss in a transaction, or with respect to some investment or set of investments, e.g., some holding; the amount one stands to lose in that transaction or investment
  Siblings: average earnings, credit rating model, mean
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/DER/DerivativesContracts/Options/RiskReversal: risk reversal — option trading strategy that consists of being short (selling) an out of the money put and being long (i.e., buying) an out of the money call, both with the same maturity
  Siblings: strangle, condor spread, fence
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Funds/CollectiveInvestmentVehicles/FundRedemptionTerms: fund redemption terms — Formal terms for redemption of units in the fund. These set out what the investor and the fund may or may not do.
  Siblings: fund processing general terms, fund subscription terms
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/TransactionsExt/MarketTransactions/MarketTransaction: market transaction — Any transaction which defines a supply of some negotiable item in return for some Consideration. The Market Transaction has a Principal and a Counterparty, i.e. it is not symmetrical.
  Siblings: contractual transaction
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/GoalsAndObjectives/Objectives/InvestmentObjective: investment objective — financial objective used by an investor to determine whether or not a given potential investment is appropriate for themselves or on behalf of another party [from restriction: hasObjective on InvestmentStrategy]
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Funds/CollectiveInvestmentVehicles/ReferToFundOrderDesk: refer to fund order desk — Restriction requiring an investor to refer to the fund order desk prior to redeeming a fund. [from restriction: hasAdditionalRedemptionRestrictions on FundRedemptionTerms]
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/TransactionsExt/MarketTransactions/MarketTransactionPaymentTerms: market transaction payment terms — None [from restriction: paymentTerms on MarketTransaction]
  Siblings: market transaction invoicing terms

axes.rationale: The risk involves the promotion or facilitation of high-risk financial activities, specifically in gambling. Financial exposure represents the extent to which an individual or organization is open to risk of suffering a loss, which is directly relevant to the concern about high-risk financial activities.

The risk involves transactions related to gambling, which can be seen as a type of market transaction involving a supply of some negotiable item in return for consideration. This is relevant as it captures the essence of the financial activities being promoted or facilitated.
